Emma — thanks for the clear summary and for the time today. Forwarding a short MAP draft and a proposed schedule below. Attaching a PDF that outlines our standard eval exchange controls and an ingestion checklist.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- Week 0 (receive): BrightWave uploads sample dataset (10k rows) + prompt pack (200) to secure transfer link provided by Redwood.
- Week 1 (onboarding): Redwood performs automated PII scan, threat scan, and mapping to ingestion schema. Security sign-off.
- Week 2 (baseline runs): Redwood runs two baseline models and shares token-level latency/cost report and qualitative failure-case samples.
- Week 3 (ops tweaks): Batch size/quantization and routing recommendations; second round of runs if needed.
- Week 4 (review & close): Joint review, acceptance criteria check, and sign-off to transition to pilot contract.

Constraints we require from BrightWave for evaluation materials:
- Materials may be used by Redwood only for the agreed evaluation of the platform and for internal quality debugging; no model training or redistribution.
- Retention window default 90 days after receipt unless an extension is mutually agreed (we can support shorter windows in a few cases).
- Any PII or sensitive records must be flagged and we will treat them per our SOC2 processes (redaction/segmentation).

If BrightWave legal would like to provide a redline, please send it to security@redwood.ai and legal@redwood.ai; our legal lead is Marissa Cole (cc'd to come). I can prep the DocuSign for the MAP once you confirm the retention and usage bullets above.

Attachments: RIF_MAP_2026-05-07.pdf (MAP draft & ingestion checklist)

Next step: If you confirm the bullets above I will provision a secure upload link and target first receipt by Friday (2026-05-08).

Thanks,
